# Company Surge® Intent data

## Fuel your B2B marketing and sales strategies  with Company Surge®. We’re not just the leader in  B2B Intent data. We invented it.

Company Surge®, Bombora’s industry-leading B2B Intent data solution, powers sales and marketing teams with actionable insights to accelerate go-to-market strategies across the buyer journey.

![](https://bombora.com/wp-content/themes/imaginarium/assets/production/images/Bombora_Internal-Headers_Gradient-Cyan@2x.png)

## From ABM to ad strategy to churn reduction:   Intent data drives results.

Prioritize in-market accounts

Building effective target account lists requires more than just firmographic data. With Company Surge®, marketing and sales teams can pinpoint the accounts most likely to be in-market for their solutions using insights from research activity across the B2B web.

![Priotitize in-market accounts](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Prioritize-in-market-accounts-1.png)

Align outreach to stages of the buyer journey

Company Surge® allows marketing and sales teams to identify where each target account is in the buying journey: early-stage research, mid-stage research, late-stage research. These insights shape marketing and sales motions, drive content strategy, and elevate ABM results.

![Intent data buyer journey](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Buyer-journey.png)

Optimize ad targeting

Maximize the effectiveness and return of your advertising investment. Bombora creates custom digital audiences that target your ideal buying group at the accounts showing Intent. This allows you to serve relevant messaging and timely ads while maximizing the return on your advertising investment.

![Optimize ad targeting](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Optimize-ad-targeting-1.png)

Customize sales outreach

Stand out from the sea of daily outreach prospects receive. Our Intent data gives you the insights to deliver tailored messaging aligned to topics actually being researched by your target accounts and buying group members, for the best chance of sparking a meaningful sales conversation.

![Customize sales outreach](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Customize-sales-outreach.png)

Personalize content and events to in-market interests

Understanding your audience’s interests is key to engaging your ideal accounts in content and events. Uncover trending topics, identify differences in topic engagement based on buying stage, and tailor invitation messaging based on seniority, interest, or geography.

![Personalize content and events](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Personalize-content-and-events-to-in-market-interests.png)

Identify expansion and churn risk early

Unlock the full power of Company Surge® Intent data by proactively identifying at-risk accounts (researching competitive solutions) and uncovering upsell and expansion opportunities across your customer base.

![Identify churn risk](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Identify-expansion-and-churn-risk-early-1.png)

[See Intent topics we track](https://bombora.com/intent-topics-we-track/)

![Priotitize in-market accounts](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bombora-Intent-data-Prioritize-in-market-accounts-1.png)

## Our Data Co‑op:a   one-of-a-kind source of Intent.

Bombora’s Intent data is derived from our one-of-a-kind Data Co-op, made up of thousands of media destinations (publishers, B2B brands, and premium data providers) that represent the full spectrum of B2B research. Our Data Co‑op is governed by persistent privacy-first, consent-driven, data collection protocols that ensure that our Intent data remains durable as the privacy landscape evolves.

Across the Co-op we track tens of thousands of topics (updated frequently) and millions of B2B domains. 86% of the data in our Data Co‑op is shared exclusively with Bombora for the purpose of deriving Intent – no other Intent data provider has access to these highly relevant signals.

[Learn more about the Data Co-op](https://bombora.com/co-op/)

![Bombora's Data Co-op](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Extended-Path-Static-Concept-Final.png-1.png)

![Essential Intent data guide](https://bombora.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Essential-Intent-data-guide-thumbnail-website.png)

Learn how activating Intent data can transform sales and marketing results.

## What makes BomboraIntent datadifferent?

Not all B2B data is created equal. Since we created the B2B Intent data category, many players have entered the space. Bombora continues to be recognized as “the gold standard”.

#### Exclusive quality at scale

Powered by our one-of-a-kind Data Co-op; 86% of our signals are exclusively shared with Bombora for the purpose of deriving Intent. Our Intent data is called “highly unique” and “future proof” by Forrester.

#### Proprietary methodologies

Bombora uses patented AI-driven Intent models that measure real research behavior over time, not just keyword spikes.

#### Privacy-first data collection

Our solutions meet leading enterprise quality and privacy standards (e.g., GDPR and CCPA). Trusted, direct-source signals ensure durability.

#### Deployable everywhere

Bombora’s Intent data integrates seamlessly into the advertising, marketing, sales and CRM platforms your teams already use. Our Intent signals can be activated wherever actions are taken.

Key questions to consider when evaluating Intent data providers.

## A closer look atIntent data

What is buyer intent data?

Buyer intent is a signal that predicts when a company is ‘in market’ for a product or solution. There are myriad sources of intent signals derived from first-party and third-party sources.

How does Bombora create Intent data?

Bombora’s Company Surge® Intent data is derived from our Data Cooperative using proprietary AI-driven machine learning and natural language processing models. Bombora continuously monitors company research activity against 21,600+ topics. To identify elevated Intent, Bombora evaluates behavioral changes across every account-topic pair, via relative, account-specific scoring that compares the most recent three weeks of activity against a 12-week historical baseline.

How is Bombora different from other Intent data providers?

Company Surge® is the only Intent data derived from a diversified Data Co-op with thousands of B2B publishers and brand sites. Research consumption is collected through a proprietary, consent-driven tag on every site in our Co-op. Bombora’s proprietary models, fueled by rich, direct engagement data, eliminate signal noise and identify true intent.

How does Company Surge® Intent data help sales and marketing teams?

Bombora’s Intent data helps sales and marketing teams identify “in-market” accounts with high propensity to buy. Marketers can build Intent-based digital ABM campaigns to engage these accounts. Sales teams use Intent data to prioritize sales motions and customize outreach. Intent data is an effective tool for unifying strategies across marketing and sales.
